scenario: LCYC.6.1 — the literal-equality cycle-breaking check admits the canonical self-edge `kind-flip` pattern: LHS where-clause `kind == "enter"` paired with RHS emit `kind: "leave"` (different literals). The compiler drops the self-edge and the rule compiles cleanly.
